title: A Great Warrior's Armor
blurb: Circe strips the stranger's story bare, lie by lie, and he can only admire her.

characters.name: Circe
characters.description: The sorceress of Aiaia. Sharp-eyed, amused, dangerous.

characters.name: Odysseus
characters.description: Starving, armed, and lying about who he is.

lines.direction: Sit back, offended. Then laugh once.

lines.text: A traveler who's clearly starving, yet hasn't touched the food in front of him, claims to be a sailor, yet wears a great warrior's armor.
lines.direction: Count his lies on your fingers. Savor each one.

lines.text: And who breaks Zeus's law… by bringing a dagger into his hostess's house.
lines.direction: Point at the dagger. Your smile is gone.
A slow nod. Respect, and a warning.

source: The Odyssey (2026 film); OBS screen recording, transcribed with ElevenLabs Scribe v2 (diarized)
